an4.50:1.1: cattārome bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
an4.50:1.3: abbhā bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkilesā yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
an4.50:2.1: mahiyā bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkilesā yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
an4.50:3.1: dhūmarajo bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
an4.50:4.1: rāhu bhikkhave asurindo candimasuriyānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
an4.50:4.2: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro candimasuriyānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
an4.50:5.1: evameva kho bhikkhave cattāro samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti
an4.50:5.3: santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā suraṃ pivanti merayaṃ surāmerayapānā appaṭiviratā
an4.50:5.4: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
an4.50:6.1: santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanti methunasmā dhammā appaṭiviratā
an4.50:6.2: ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
an4.50:7.1: santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā jātarūparajataṃ sādiyanti jātarūparajatapaṭiggahaṇā appaṭiviratā
an4.50:7.2: ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
an4.50:8.1: santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti micchājīvā appaṭiviratā
an4.50:8.2: ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
an4.50:8.3: ime kho bhikkhave cattāro samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocantīti.
